scientific_integrity: Analytical proof supplied for every degree and boundary case. Exact-arithmetic checks are finite diagnostics only. Bibliographically relevant 2010 and 2014 full texts were inaccessible and were not treated as fully inspected.
scientific_limitations: One-particle dimension finite; the compact-difference and Schatten-membership implications are qualitatively covered by earlier results. Exact principal-angle singular spectra and the Hilbert--Schmidt norm are the quantitative claims. Earlier quantitative formulations remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Principal-angle spectra for commutators of Gaussian-Fock composition projections
